arg.name: launch_pointcloud_container
arg.description: if true, launch pointcloud container. Please note that it is not intended to launch pointcloud_container_name with the same name in other launch files.

arg.name: pointcloud_container_name
arg.description: name of pointcloud container

arg.name: use_empty_dynamic_object_publisher
arg.description: if true, /perception/object_recognition/objects topic has an empty DynamicObjectArray

arg.name: use_traffic_light_recognition
arg.description: use traffic light recognition module, if false, traffic light recognition module will not be launched

arg.name: use_low_height_cropbox
arg.description: use low height crop filter in clustering

arg.name: use_vector_map
arg.description: use vector map in prediction

arg.name: use_pointcloud_map
arg.description: use pointcloud map in detection

arg.name: use_irregular_object_detector
arg.description: enable pipeline for small unknown object detection

arg.name: use_low_intensity_cluster_filter
arg.description: launch low_intensity_cluster_filter in clustering

arg.name: use_image_segmentation_based_filter
arg.description: launch image_segmentation_based_filter in clustering

arg.name: use_perception_online_evaluator
arg.description: launch perception online evaluator

arg.name: use_perception_analytics_publisher
arg.description: launch perception analytics publisher

arg.name: use_detection_by_tracker
arg.description: launch detection_by_tracker function

arg.name: use_radar_tracking_fusion
arg.description: if true, radar objects are merged in tracking module. Otherwise, radar objects are merged in detection module.

arg.name: use_object_filter
arg.description: launch object filter to filter-out detected object

arg.name: use_obstacle_segmentation_single_frame_filter
arg.description: use single frame filter at the ground segmentation

arg.name: use_obstacle_segmentation_time_series_filter
arg.description: use time series filter at the ground segmentation

arg.name: segmentation_pointcloud_fusion_camera_ids
arg.description: list of camera ids used for segmentation_pointcloud_fusion node, mainly using front camera

arg.name: use_multi_channel_tracker_merger
arg.description: if true, multi channel tracker merger is used. Otherwise, merged object is used.

arg.name: use_camera_vru_detector
arg.description: enable pipeline for camera VRU object detection

arg.name: camera_vru_detector_rois_ids
arg.description: list of ROIs ids used for detecting VRU.

arg.name: detected_objects_filter_method
arg.description: options: lanelet_filter, position_filter

arg.name: detected_objects_validation_method
arg.description: options: obstacle_pointcloud, occupancy_grid (must be used with laserscan_based_occupancy_grid_map)

arg.name: data_path
arg.description: packages data and artifacts directory path

arg.name: lidar_detection_model
arg.description: If the model name is not declared, the default model in perception.launch.xml will be used

arg.name: ml_camera_lidar_merger_priority_mode
arg.description: priority mode for ml and camera_lidar merger, options: `0: Object0`, `1: Object1`, `2: ConfidenceBased`, `3: ClassBased`

arg.name: input_pointcloud_for_traffic_light_occlusion_predictor
arg.description: input pointcloud topic for traffic_light_occlusion_predictor

arg.name: traffic_light_recognition/camera_namespaces
arg.description: choose camera which use for traffic light recognition

arg.name: traffic_light_recognition/use_high_accuracy_detection
arg.description: select whether to use high accuracy detector for traffic light recognition

arg.name: traffic_light_recognition/high_accuracy_detection_type
arg.description: select high accuracy detector type for traffic light recognition: fine_detection or whole_image_detection
